term: simple part as minimal non-null object
definition: In a partial-order parthood domain, a simple lacks proper parts: Mathlib IsMin. AtomicParts says every object contains such a simple part, possibly itself. Composite reuses the existing predicate of having a proper part. There is no OrderBot, null constituent, atom-count bound or global well-foundedness assumption.
note: This is ONLY a weaker consequence of primary P2. Rutten Step1p127 and pp129–131 use terminating proper-part descent. Standard nonempty composition/parthood makes his terminating-simple decomposition supply this weaker existence claim; the full source commitment is not replaced by it.
